# get_data_from_mofdb { #mofography.data.get_data_from_mofdb }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Async MOFdb search download into a pandas DataFrame (main MOFdb entry point).

```python
data.get_data_from_mofdb(
    url='https://mof.tech.northwestern.edu/mofs.json',
    params={'vf_min': 0.1, 'vf_max': 1.0, 'database': 'IZA', 'page': 1},
    headers={'loading': 'cm3(STP)/cm3', 'pressure': 'bar'},
    npages=None,
    limit=1000,
)
```

Download MOFdb search pages in parallel and return a combined results DataFrame.
